quickref.name: Abusement Park
quickref.era: Added in BBR v1.3.2 (iOS notes dated Aug 24, 2012 [Game text via wiki]); skybox fixed in 1.3.4 (Oct 20, 2012); carried into BBG (2013 onward) with no documented rework
quickref.in_2026: Not named in the Steam store text [Canon]. Its red base appears in the official Steam trailer at about 17.75-22.0 s [Observed], and the 2026 OST opens with 'Abusement Park' (0:54) and adds 'Abusement Park (Full Version)' (3:05) [Canon]. Very likely in rotation [Inference], unconfirmed.
quickref.setting: A run-down, horror-tinged night carnival sealed inside tall cracked stone walls [Observed]. 'Horror-themed carnival' [Fan-wiki]. Signs read 'ONLY ONE CAN LEAVE', '[NO ENTRY]', 'CONDEMNED', and the EXIT costs 'Only 400,000 Tix' [Observed]. No stated location.
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Dusk-to-night plum sky #221127 with violet clouds #1c1739-#2a1b37 and a maroon horizon glow #462939-#643e45. Grey-mauve stone walls #786a71, grimy asphalt #3b3939. Warm salmon red-base deck #fea47e with red stencils #fd1b13; cool blue-side deck #9e8565-#bab9a0 with blue graffiti #074977. Tents: maroon/white #5f0903, orange/yellow #df6422/#fecc54, green #709342, blue/white with white sawtooth trim. Yellow U-rails #feb625, bunting red #a11104 / teal #2f8c9e, coaster cars #4ebe01 with pink Huggables #d7019d. Baked theatrical lighting with bulb marquees and teal jump pads.
quickref.landmarks: Perimeter roller coaster on red-white candy-striped pylons, with lime-green cars ridden by grinning pink Huggables. Red base: '[RED]' stencil wall, red stars, salmon plank deck, yellow U-rails. The Mirrored House (mirror-written marquee, 'LIKE A HOUSE BUT BACKWARDS'). The Pump-A-Chump 'FULLA' LEAD' shooting gallery. A big maroon-and-white square tent with three green peaked tents and an octagonal striped gazebo. EXIT stairs under 'Only 400,000 Tix' and a metal arch daubed 'ONLY ONE CAN LEAVE'.
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: No environmental hazards documented. Jump pads; pickups (Bearscream Sandwich in the gazebo near Blue's spawn). Easter eggs: Battle Bears Fortress tower teaser posters ('Waste Chewer', 'Robowizardhat'); twin posters of an unreleased Soldier skin (per wiki); 'Not Wil's CANDY STASH' scrawl over a burnt hole; 'Jeepers Peepers! / WHAT'S IN THE BOX?' banner; 'SLOWBURN II - You're toast.' evil-toaster movie poster and toaster cutout; 'RED' painted in blue on the Blue side; 'BBR FOREVER' (wiki) or 'BBR #1' (as observed) graffiti; '[RATE US ...]' stencil with stars; 'Fried Stick on a Stick'; a 'CONDEMNED' crate; a Mos Delish poster (wiki, unverified).
